colibri-qwen36.note: Run on colibri dev (eefa57a+): native tool calls (#1794) + prefix reuse (#1767). ram = governor estimate only (qwen36 ignores --ram); memory/speed set by --cap (cap 256: ~14 GB, ~2.7 tok/s). On v1.12.1 instead: env COLI_TOOL_FALLBACK=1 + patches/0001.

colibri-olmoe-tiny.note: TEST FIXTURE ONLY - random weights (tools/make_olmoe_tiny.py); exercises engine + gateway.

colibri-qwen38-flash-next.note: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next FP8 125B(+51B n-gram)/6B, engine qwen38, pinned rev bcd9f01. Smoke 2026-09-29 (during a parallel download): RSS 11.8 GB at cap 32, native tools OK, 380-token turn 299 s. ram 14 = measured + margin. --no-think (thinks by default). pi task 2026-09-29: 29 min, rounds 1401/165/98/76 s (prefix reuse working).
